ios.desc:
BLECI Debugger Pro is a powerful BLE debugging tool for developers, hardware engineers, and testers.

Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices, inspect GATT services and characteristics, send custom Hex commands, enable notifications, and review live logs in one place.

Build reusable Profiles for the devices you work with. Save commands, data parsers, receive rules, timers, services, characteristics, and connection workflows so you can debug faster and reduce repeated manual work.

Key features:
• Scan nearby BLE peripherals
• Filter devices by name, RSSI, and advertised Service UUID
• Connect and inspect GATT services and characteristics
• Read values, write Hex commands, and enable notifications
• Create reusable device Profiles
• Configure commands with flexible payloads
• Build parsers for raw bytes and Hex data
• Set receive rules and timers
• Inspect SYSTEM, TX, RX, PARSE, and ERROR logs
• Search logs by keyword, UUID, characteristic, or Hex data
• Share live logs over a local network
• Use the built-in guide to learn BLE debugging workflows

Designed for BLE development, firmware testing, hardware integration, protocol debugging, and device validation.
